Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that handles partial and final streaming recognition events using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 2 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 3 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 4 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 5 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 6 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk
import os
import asyncio

async def transcribe_streaming_audio(audio_stream):
    """
    Transcribes an audio stream using Azure Speech-to-Text, handling partial and final results.

    Args:
        audio_stream: An iterable of audio data chunks (e.g., bytes).
                      For a real-time scenario, this would typically come from a microphone.
                      For demonstration, it can be a generator yielding simulated audio chunks.

    Returns:
        A list of recognized final phrases.
    """
    speech_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
    service_region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")

    if not speech_key or not service_region:
        raise ValueError("Please set the AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION environment variables.")

    speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=service_region)
    speech_config.speech_recognition_language = "en-US"

    # Create a push audio input stream
    push_stream = speechsdk.audio.PushAudioInputStream()
    audio_config = speechsdk.audio.AudioConfig(stream=push_stream)

    speech_recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(
        speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=audio_config
    )

    recognized_phrases = []
    
    # Event handlers for recognition events
    def recognized_cb(evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        if evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech:
            recognized_phrases.append(evt.result.text)
            # print(f"FINAL: {evt.result.text}")
        elif evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.NoMatch:
            # print("NOMATCH: Speech could not be recognized.")
            pass

    def recognizing_cb(evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionEventArgs):
        if evt.result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizingSpeech:
            # print(f"PARTIAL: {evt.result.text}")
            pass

    def canceled_cb(evt: speechsdk.SpeechRecognitionCanceledEventArgs):
        # print(f"CANCELED: Reason={evt.reason}")
        if evt.reason == speechsdk.CancellationReason.Error:
            # print(f"CANCELED: ErrorDetails={evt.error_details}")
            pass

    def session_started_cb(evt: speechsdk.SessionEventArgs):
        # print("SESSION STARTED")
        pass

    def session_stopped_cb(evt: speechsdk.SessionEventArgs):
        # print("SESSION STOPPED")
        pass

    speech_recognizer.recognized.connect(recognized_cb)
    speech_recognizer.recognizing.connect(recognizing_cb)
    speech_recognizer.canceled.connect(canceled_cb)
    speech_recognizer.session_started.connect(session_started_cb)
    speech_recognizer.session_stopped.connect(session_stopped_cb)

    # Start continuous recognition
    speech_recognizer.start_continuous_recognition()

    # Feed audio chunks into the push stream
    try:
        for chunk in audio_stream:
            push_stream.write(chunk)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01) # Simulate processing time, adjust as needed
    finally:
        # Signal the end of the audio stream
        push_stream.close()
        # Stop continuous recognition
        speech_recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition()

    return recognized_phrases
